name: Montgomery County, IA
findings: Montgomery County has 120 nonprofit organizations. 25 of them (21%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 21 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (43% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Montgomery County has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in Montgomery County list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.8 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 21 organizations here; 49% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are public events so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
